documents.title: System & Hardware Requirements Specification (HRS)
documents.summary: Master requirements document defining functional, physical, power, locomotion, and multi-agent communication requirements for the MARS robot unit.

versions.author: MARS Hardware Team
changes: Initial baseline structure for Requirements Engineering phase
Defined system-level operational envelope and target payload capacity
Added preliminary power budget and battery endurance requirements

documents.title: Multi-Agent Sensing & Localization Requirements
documents.summary: Specification of onboard perception, relative localization, UWB/wireless ranging, and compute latency requirements for cooperative multi-robot navigation.

versions.author: MARS Hardware Team
changes: Updated field-of-view (FoV) overlap requirements for peer-to-peer robot detection
Added UWB inter-agent ranging accuracy requirement (+/- 10 cm at 15 m)
Refined thermal dissipation limits for onboard edge compute module

versions.author: MARS Hardware Team
changes: Initial draft of sensor suite and compute hardware requirements
Defined baseline camera, IMU, and wheel odometry interface requirements

documents.title: Hardware Architecture & Subsystem Interface Control (ICD)
